page.layout: One page of running text in one column, right of centre. Margin notes in the left margin: a three-line Latin note beside "recensa", and a three-line black-letter German note beside "habet". Page number and running head at the top left. No catchword or signature.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas:

main_text.l: amnis, ubi Delfsilæus portus & castellum,
milliare dimidium: vallo, fossa, portis
quondam munita ab Edsardo ante annos
centum, & triennio post à Georgio Sa-
xone civitatis quoque jure atque ordine
magistratuum donata; sed his ab eodem
post annos xii, illis à Geldro anno se-
quente rursus exuta nudataque: à Tau-
tenburgio demum Burgundiæ militiæ
duce anno M. D. xxxv i excidio damnata,
& vix precibus suorum incolumis conser-
vata. Ipsa caput quondam Fivelgoniæ:
à cujus Ordinibus jura ejus qualiacunque
ac statuta vetera, per manus accepta, &
in more posita, quæ privilegia sua Dam-
monenses vocant, solenni in conventu,
anno post Natalem Christi M. CCC.XXVII
recensa probataque, & mox paucos post
dies ab omnibus quoque Frisiis in comitiis
universægentis ad Vpstallesbomum con-
firmata esse, in Historia exposui. In statu-
tis his hæc reperio, Dammonam, ut nunc

l.i: habet, ita tunc habuisse judices suos ex in-
digenis lectos: his finito muneris sui tempore
(triennè id esse solet) cum primario loci sa-
cerdote jus fuisse, die xxii Februarij fuc-cessores

page.notes: The left-margin notes are partly worn. The first reads "Litere de iureDam-monesium, vulgodicta" and the second is black letter; the second note's first word "De Buer" and its middle line "Vzieff bā" are doubtful and could be misread. The final word "cessores" is set in italic and is partly hidden by the page edge, so the completion of "fuc-" is uncertain; it may read "successores" in full. The digitiser's "Digitized by Google" mark at lower right is omitted.
